rules.label: Inactivity for 3 minutes
rules.definition: Neither participant has taken a visible action for at least two minutes. Visible activity includes chat messages and measurement actions.
monitorSignals: No participant chat messages for at least two minutes.
No new measurements for at least two minutes.
Measurement activity counts as active collaboration even if the chat is quiet.

rules.label: Unbalanced participation
rules.definition: One participant is carrying most of the visible contribution while the other contributes little or mostly minimal acknowledgements.
monitorSignals: One participant contributes substantially more turns than the other.
The quieter participant mostly sends short acknowledgements or almost nothing.
The exchange does not show shared contribution.

rules.label: Shared uncertainty
rules.definition: Both participants express uncertainty about the same question, interpretation, or next step, and the conversation does not resolve it.
monitorSignals: Both participants signal confusion, uncertainty, or not knowing.
Their uncertainty is about the same concept, decision, or interpretation.
The exchange remains unresolved instead of converging on a next step.

shouldFlagIf: At least one rule is clearly present in the recent collaboration activity.
The pattern is likely to block progress or weaken collaboration.
shouldNotFlagIf: The partners are already recovering on their own.
The collaboration is active because they are still sending messages or taking measurements.
Only one participant is uncertain, or both are uncertain about different things.
